text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe, to think that my trainer would reward me with such a veritable feast of desserts. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: They have a limited supply, though, so we should go before they run out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen's achievements have left a lasting mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've successfully navigated the crucial initial three years together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, it only just ended, and honestly, the feeling hasn't had a chance to sink in yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Two orders of the Stacked Strawberry Afternoon Tea Set, please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If these are like the pictures, we're about to experience three tiers of sublime sweetness!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe, just imagining it is making my mouth water in anticipation. ♪
choice_data_list: You were holding yourself back before your races, huh?
You were holding yourself back before your races, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urk… You're bringing that up now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This is supposed to be a time for us to relax and destress.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Though, now that I think about it, it was thanks to sweets that you and I first met.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, I was able to achieve my goal without giving up either sweets or racing.
choice_data_list: So you're saying it's all thanks to me?
So you're saying it's all thanks to me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good grief, someone sure is full of themselves today.

text_block_list.name: Male Viewer
text_block_list.text: Oh, "Peak Umamusume" is starting! I love this show!

text_block_list.name: Female Viewer
text_block_list.text: You really like that segment, huh? You're always watching it.

text_block_list.name: Male Viewer
text_block_list.text: It's super intense right now! I mean, in the recent autumn Tenno Sho—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh… the autumn Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I wonder if they're airing that interview now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing the words "autumn Tenno Sho" and "interview" brings back a certain memory.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Hello there, Miss McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello. Come to think of it, it's interview day, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: If you don't mind, I'd like to ask you some questions.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I don't mind at all. Please ask whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: First of all, congratulations on your successive wins in the spring and autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Now seems like the perfect time for you to take a break. What are you going to do first?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmmm. First, I plan to devour sweets to my heart's—ahh!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Sweets, you say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: N-no! That's not it! Um… I'm going to train!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Oh! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: You're still aiming high even after reaching your goal. That's our McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Uh, no… I'm sorry. That was just—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series may be over, but you're keeping your eyes on the next prize!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Be sure to watch her, everyone! She's going to go far!

text_block_list.name: Male Viewer
text_block_list.text: Whoa… McQueen's really something! She said she's still aiming to achieve more!

text_block_list.name: Female Viewer
text_block_list.text: What, really?! Lemme see!

text_block_list.name: Male Viewer
text_block_list.text: But what happens if she just keeps getting better? Won't it get boring?

text_block_list.name: Female Viewer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, right? She'll end up winning every single race.

text_block_list.name: Female Viewer
text_block_list.text: But y'know, being so strong that every race is a bore is kinda cool in its own way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wha—That's the footage they decided to air?! I'm so embarrassed…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …But wait, did I hear those people say I'm becoming so strong that I'm boring?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …I see. They wouldn't speak that way if they weren't convinced I'd win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, but… if that's the case, does that make you "boring" as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I suppose you'd be boring McQueen's boring trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's just like you to get carried away so quickly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Still… I like the sound of that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The ultimate pair, so strong that we'll bore you to sleep! Hehe!
